routines.name: Beginner Full Body Week
routines.description: Two full-body sessions and one light conditioning circuit, with a mobility day. Recommended for anyone new to training.

recovery: Keep at least one full rest day each week and avoid training the same muscles hard on consecutive days.
Sleep, food and easy walking do more for your progress than adding extra sessions.
progression: Stay with the same workouts until the last set of each exercise feels comfortable for two sessions in a row.
Then add one or two reps, or one more set, to one or two exercises. Change one thing at a time.
safety: Stop if you feel sharp pain, dizziness or chest discomfort, and seek medical advice.
Talk to a healthcare professional before starting if you have a health condition, injury or are pregnant.
